title: understudy.verifier_handoff.v1
description: The RL-handoff packet written to .understudy/verifier-handoff/handoff.json by prepare-verifier-handoff. Stage 0 records the confirmed need (the later stages refuse to run without it); stage 2 appends the package location, conformance status, return-eval command, and pinned reward definition. Most fields are nullable so a packet can be started at stage 0 and enriched per stage. Producers may add extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand. This packet is a local artifact — it must never contain prompts, traces, source files, keys, or secrets.

schema_version.description: Version stamp for this packet shape.

workload_id.description: Identifier of the workload being made partner-ready.

owner.description: Who owns the workload/decision (a role or handle, not private contact data).

source_refs.description: Paths or ids of the local evidence this packet is grounded in (workload card, claim packet, scored-rollout artifacts). References only — never inline contents.

evidence_level.description: Evidence rung reached before the handoff decision (e.g. frozen-eval, a-b-compare, optimized-prompt, holdout-validated).

why_rl_required.description: Why evaluation, A/B comparison, and local prompt/route optimization cannot satisfy the need — i.e. what requires learned policy training. Stage 0's confirmed-need record.

reward_summary.description: Summary of the validator or reward signal (axes, dense vs strict, rewardability verdict).

environment_shape.description: Shape of the environment: one or more of stateless, stateful, tool-use, browser, code, simulation.

boundary.description: The train/dev/holdout boundary in force (e.g. 'seed-7: train 18 / dev 6 / holdout 6').

splits_sha256.description: sha256 of the frozen split contract (matches capture-evidence splits_sha256).

contamination.description: Whether the RL train pool has been verified to exclude frozen dev/holdout rows (curate-trajectories contamination report).

data_class.description: Sensitivity class of the workload data (e.g. synthetic, internal, customer).

upload_boundary.description: What may leave the machine for the partner engagement, stated explicitly (e.g. 'env module + synthetic fixtures only; no captures').

cap_usd.description: Approved spend ceiling for the hosted run. Null when not yet set.

approval.description: Approval status for the hosted engagement.

fallback_route.description: What ships if hosted training is not approved or fails (e.g. 'stay on incumbent route at 100%').

recommended_partner.description: Recommended partner path — Prime Intellect Verifiers unless the evidence packet suggests another public partner is a better fit.

location.description: Local path of the packaged Verifiers-compatible module (e.g. .understudy/verifier-env/pi_verifiers_env.py).

conformance.description: Trainer-free conformance check result. fail blocks the handoff.

conformance_rollouts.description: N rollouts executed by the conformance check.

oracle_score.description: The seeded oracle trajectory's score from the conformance run (must match its expected value).

return_eval_command.description: The exact command that re-scores a returned policy on the frozen holdout (refuses on holdout-hash mismatch).

reward_kind.description: Pinned reward definition: terminal fractional final-state score by default; any shaping explicit and optional.

scorer_ref.description: Reference to the local scorer imported as the single source of truth (so remote_reward == local_reward by construction).

package.description: Stage-2 additions: package location, conformance status, the exact return-eval command, and the pinned reward definition.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the packet was first written.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the latest stage update.
